AUTHOR: Paraschiv
TITLE: Classification of Underwater Fish Images and Videos via Very Small Convolutional Neural Networks
VENUE: JOURNAL OF MARINE SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING
REGION: Eastern Mediterranean off Haifa, Israel (THEMO deep and shallow moorings); training data from mixed sources
SPECIES: albacore, greater amberjack, Atlantic mackerel, dolphinfish, Mediterranean horse mackerel, swordfish
DATA: Symbiosis dataset compiled from private/public underwater photos and videos (51,260 segments); QUT + NOAA Labeled Fishes in the Wild (other-species class); Symbiosis platform sea trials at THEMO (24 + 115 segments)
V_EV: Sec. 4.1-4.2: 'six strobe units... help image capture in low-light conditions'; fish at 'a distance of 1 m to 10 m from one or more cameras'; platform 'placed 10 m below the surface'
D2: 60/20/20 per species, segments of the same video kept in one set; additional experiments 80/10/10 (video-grouped and random 'Mix')
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'we kept segments from the same videos together in the same set... avoiding that very similar images from the same video spread from the training set to the validation and test sets'
R_EV: Table 4 vs Table 9: six-species accuracy on held-out dataset (VGG16 51.37%) vs THEMO sea-trial segments (VGG16 86.11% Deep, 32.46% Shallow)
C_EV: no statement found (softmax class output with mean/max/voting over tracks; no score threshold, reject or unsure rule)
ARCH: Very small CNNs (10-50k params), VGG16 (last layer retrained), Chollet CNN, MobileNetV3; SORT tracking with voting; RetinaNet-based segmentation upstream
NOTE: Training dataset compiled from heterogeneous private/public sources (some Wikipedia/web photos; QUT Kaggle and NOAA images for 'other species'), but the system is evaluated quantitatively on in situ sea-trial imagery from the authors' moored platform (Table 9) -> INCL=Y (verify). External: sea-trial imagery from a different camera system/site than the compiled training data -> R1=Y, R3=Y; note THEMO models trained on train+test union and test sets are tiny and almost all Seriola. NCC similarity filtering (D3) used for additional experiments; Mix vs No-mix comparison explicitly discusses leakage (D4). Classification-only without threshold -> C_ALL=NA. VGG16 pretraining source not named.
